title: No Metrolink service between Rochdale Town Centre and Freehold after collision at Westwood
excerpt: A road traffic collision at Westwood stopped Metrolink services between Rochdale Town Centre and Freehold on Monday 12 October, with tram tickets accepted on 17 bus routes.
body:
A road traffic collision at Westwood stopped Metrolink services between Rochdale Town Centre and Freehold on the evening of Monday 12 October 2026, according to a Bee Network travel alert.

The section affected covers every tram stop in the borough on the Oldham and Rochdale line, including Rochdale Town Centre, Rochdale Railway Station, Newbold, Kingsway Business Park, Milnrow and Newhey.

While the line was closed, tram tickets were accepted on the 17, 57, 59, 76, 76A, 81, 83, 84, 114, 149, 181, 182, 409, 411, 435, 436 and 471 bus services.

The alert did not give a time for services to resume. Current service information is on the Bee Network travel alerts page: https://tfgm.com/travel-updates/travel-alerts

corrections.note: This story originally said bus services were suspended. The Bee Network alert said there was no service between Rochdale Town Centre and Freehold, which is the Metrolink line, and that tram tickets were accepted on buses. The headline and report have been corrected, and two sentences not supported by the alert have been removed.
